key_insight: SympFormer derives accelerated attention blocks from inertial, damped Hamiltonian dynamics on spaces of probability measures.
engineering_relevance: This geometric framework motivates token and momentum corrections that improve next-token prediction over momentum-only controls in nanoGPT-style experiments.
method: Develop local-mobility geometry for Otto- and softmax-Wasserstein settings and quotient Stein geometry for linear attention.
Establish conditions for gradient-flow and damped Hamiltonian formulations, plus global existence versus moment blow-up for linear attention.
Translate finite-token geometry into corrected token and momentum updates.
evidence_signal: Decoder-only experiments on TinyStories and OpenWebText report lower validation negative log-likelihood with geometric corrections than with momentum-only controls.
watch_item: The theory requires characterized domains and conditions; reported experiments do not establish stability or performance at large-model scale.
paper_title: SympFormer: Inertial Attention Blocks from Damped Hamiltonian Dynamics on Spaces of Probability Measures
